Glance 2026.09.29.2 adds optional file format identification.

- Identify unknown files by their contents with the File Format Identification component, powered by bundled Siegfried data.
- View the identified format, MIME type, extensions and matching information in generic preview details. Open supported formats with the identified format while preserving the original file.
- Cancel identification when switching or closing previews, with bounded processing time and memory usage.
- Display empty JSON files without a parse warning.
